common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
common.footer: This message was sent automatically by LibreFolio from $instance.

password_reset.subject: Reset your LibreFolio password
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your account on $instance.
password_reset.expiry: The link works only once and expires in $duration.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.
password_reset.restore_subject: Choose a new password for LibreFolio
password_reset.restore_intro: Your account on $instance was restored from a backup.
password_reset.restore_note: For your security, your password was revoked after the restore. Use the button below to choose a new one.
password_reset.restore_fallback: If the link has expired, choose “Forgot Password?” on the sign-in page, with this email address, to get a new one.
password_reset.restore_unexpected: If you were not expecting this, contact whoever manages this LibreFolio.

invite.subject: You are invited to LibreFolio
invite.intro: $inviter invites you to create an account on $instance.
invite.intro_anonymous: You have been invited to create an account on $instance.
invite.admin_role: Your account will be an administrator of the instance.
invite.expiry: The invitation works only once and expires in $duration.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

email_verification.subject: Confirm your email address
email_verification.intro: Confirm that this email address belongs to your account on $instance.
email_verification.expiry: The link works only once and expires in $duration.
email_verification.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

admin_setup.subject: Set up your LibreFolio administrator account
admin_setup.intro: Your LibreFolio instance $instance is ready: choose the password of your administrator account to start using it.
admin_setup.expiry: The link works only once and expires in $duration.
admin_setup.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it.

test.subject: LibreFolio test email
test.intro: This is a test email sent from $instance.
test.outro: If you are reading it, LibreFolio can send emails.

email_changed.subject: The email address of your LibreFolio account changed
email_changed.intro: The email address of your account on $instance was changed. This message goes to the address it had before.
email_changed.advice: If you made this change, there is nothing to do. If you did not, someone may be using your account: change your password at once if you can still sign in, and tell the administrator of $instance.

email_change_confirmation.subject: Confirm the new email address of your LibreFolio administrator account
email_change_confirmation.intro: This email address was set as the address of the administrator account of your LibreFolio instance $instance. Confirm that it is yours to complete the change: until you do, nothing changes and the account keeps its current address.
email_change_confirmation.expiry: The link works only once and expires in $duration. Once confirmed, the account signs in with this address and its open sessions end.
email_change_confirmation.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it: nothing changes.
